faqs.title: Frequently Asked
faqs.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our makeup and beauty services.
faqs.imageAlt: Bride with emerald jewellery and floral hairstyle

items.question: What makeup services do you offer?
items.answer: We offer a wide range of services including bridal makeup, engagement makeup, party makeup, editorial makeup, and personalized beauty consultations.

items.question: Do you provide bridal makeup at the venue?
items.answer: Yes, our artists can travel to your home, hotel or wedding venue so you can get ready comfortably. Travel charges may apply depending on the location.

items.question: How early should I book my appointment?
items.answer: We recommend booking 2 to 3 months before your wedding date, especially for peak wedding season. For parties and other occasions, 1 to 2 weeks ahead is usually enough.

items.question: Do you use premium and skin-friendly products?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use high-quality, long-lasting products from trusted brands, and we can adapt to your skin type and any sensitivities or allergies.

items.question: Can I do a makeup trial before the final booking?
items.answer: Yes, we offer makeup trials so you can finalize your look with our artist before the big day. Please contact us to schedule one.
